root_exact_check.statement_fidelity: SourceClaim: for all n >= 11 there is J ⊆ ZMod n with (circulantGraph J).diam = 2 and mpNumber = 2. mpNumber is the maximum card of a finset with no three distinct members on a common induced path (InducedPath: injective, adjacency iff consecutive indices). It matches the MathDB/source statement; the refutation instance is n = 15.
root_exact_check.ordinary_proof: A triangle is an mp-set (three pairwise-adjacent vertices cannot be pairwise consecutive on an induced path). Three vertices with identical open neighbourhoods form an mp-set. Root independently enumerated all 128 symmetric jump sets on Z/15: the only triangle-free graphs of diameter 2 are {1,4,6} and {2,3,7} (isomorphic via multiplication by 2, C5 blow-ups), and both have twins 0, 5, 10.
root_exact_check.context: Source Theorem 4.4 (some graph exists iff n in {3,4,5,8} or n >= 11) was verified by an unpublished computer search (Erskine, personal communication) for n <= 32. The conjecture strengthens it to circulants. The lane's exhaustive and sampled searches find circulant examples at 11-14, 16-21, 22, 23, 24, 31 and 32; n = 15 appears to be an isolated exception.
open_gates: prior art 2021-2026 on monophonic position numbers of circulant/Cayley graphs
significance: an isolated-exception refutation versus a domain correction

decision: forward to independent review (circulant-review-r1); zero credit until acceptance
